notes.ground: The wood's floor is moss and olive litter at albedo 0.04-0.05, a sixth of Four Gates' grass, so its roads are painted half as bright (path_luma 0.1; at the default 0.24 its paths were cream decals 2.2-2.4 times the floor's luminance) and in the wood's ochre-tan rather than in pale stone. Its earthy verge is deepened less than the default (0.9): at 0.8 the floor sank to olive mud under its crowns. The floor changes at its border with Four Gates' grass, so these trims draw no seam there.
notes.grass: Dry straw and amber: its floor is half as bright as Four Gates' grass, so its grass is too.
